00014: 2. `exec/dc/pc_le/mapcoords.dcb`: `MAP_COORDS_PERM_DATA`, type `tMapCoordsInfo` (`0x40A`). Each `tMapCoords` (`0x409`) has matching `uID`, WAD name, position, forward vector, radius controls and in-world marker distance.
00015: 3. `exec/dc/pc_le/compassgraph.dcb`: `COMPASS_HELPER_PERM_DATA` (`0x40C`) and `COMPASS_GRAPH_EDGE_PERM_DATA` (`0x40E`). Helpers have their own IDs, WADs, positions and types. Each edge names `firstMarker` and `secondMarker` by hash. Edges reference both map-coordinate IDs and helper IDs.
